source.stem: Why is the circulatory system of mammals described as a double circulation?

options.text: Blood flows firstly through arteries and then through veins.
Blood flows through the heart twice on one complete circuit of the body.
In the heart, blood flows firstly through atria and then through ventricles.
The atria and the ventricles contract alternately.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Proteins and fats are the energy-giving components.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Only carbohydrates are energy-giving; fats are foods to avoid.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Glucose water is not energy-giving because it looks like plain water.

intelligence.enrichment: Carbohydrates and fats provide energy for performing activities, so they are called energy-giving foods. presence of carbohydrates or fats in food -> energy available for activities The learner correctly applies this rule: Carbohydrates and fats provide energy for performing activities, so they are called energy-giving foods. Only sweet foods give energy, and fats such as ghee or oils are never energy-giving foods.
